text: hell yeah thats what im talkin about. alright lets get all out 'picking' out of the way since its applicable to all the three tool shapes here being faces edges and verts, we want a shift select to pick multiples, and then heres one i saw that i genuinely like is you know how you can like drag select and highlight all the icons on a desktop, so think of that, but you hold down alt and then start from off the model, and drag to highlight as many faces/verts/edges in one sweep rather than the one by one dread that i have also unfortunately been living lmao
resolution: Alt+drag rubber-band marquee select for faces/verts/edges (and confirmed shift-click multi-select already works in every mode via the additive pick path). Hold Alt and drag a rectangle from anywhere; every element whose screen point (face centroid / vertex / edge midpoint) falls inside is selected in one sweep. mesh_edit.boxSelect projects each element with the exact render camera (model_paint.project) and selects those inside the rect, recomputed live on every drag move so faces highlight underneath as the box grows; the face highlight is delta-tinted so the GPU upload is proportional to what entered/left, not the whole selection. Shift+Alt sweeps to ADD by unioning with a pre-gesture snapshot. The host box-select runs per move (instant, React-free); only the marquee rectangle itself is a per-move setState (a pointerEvents-off overlay Box, a brief intentional gesture, and Scene3D doesn't re-upload since the hostKey is stable). Door __mesh_edit_box; 3d.zig meshEditBox builds the camera like the other mesh-edit doors. Unit-tested (full-viewport rect selects all 4 verts / both faces, tiny corner rect selects none, additive box unions the snapshot); built clean; render regression check passes. Live marquee feel + the box visual verify in rjit dev.
